title: The agent loop
hints: The skeleton: for _ in range(max_steps): call the model, append the assistant turn, return if stop_reason is not "tool_use", otherwise run the tools and append one user message. After the loop: raise RuntimeError("too many steps").
Running one block: function = functions.get(block["name"]), then str(function(**block["input"])).
Wrap the call in try/except Exception as error, and build {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": block["id"], "content": f"error: {error}", "is_error": True}.
